title: Permanent software-engineering modularity enforcement: root CLAUDE.md principle, AGENTS.md rule, path-scoped code-architecture rule, CODE_MODULARITY_POLICY.md, deterministic CI modularity checker, task/review integration (D-017 amendment)
objective: Make the modularity and code-organization requirements permanent repository rules per D-017-R105..R113: concise root CLAUDE.md principle; equivalent AGENTS.md rule for Codex review; auto-loading .claude/rules/code-architecture.md for handwritten Python/TypeScript/TSX production source; docs/CODE_MODULARITY_POLICY.md as the detailed source of truth; a deterministic CI modularity checker (handwritten-only, exclusions, hard/warning thresholds, versioned reviewed baseline that cannot be casually regenerated, explicit expiring path-specific exceptions, deterministic output, line count never sole proof); task-packet/coding-workflow/code-review-checklist integration; continuing enforcement proven by the seven D-017-R113 tests.
business_reason: Owner directive: modularity rules are permanent repository law, not initiative-scoped; new giant-file regressions must fail CI after the initiative ends.

acceptance_scenarios.given: a NEW 1100-SLOC handwritten production module with no exception
a grandfathered file grown past max(50,10%) over its recorded size

acceptance_scenarios.when: --check runs before and after growth past its ceiling
acceptance_scenarios.then: passes, then exception_exceeded; a grossly broad ceiling fails exception_too_broad (test_5, test_6f)

acceptance_scenarios.given: an expired, broadened, mistargeted, malformed, or duplicate exception
acceptance_scenarios.then: fails closed with a structured error (test_6, 6b, 6c, 6d, 6e)

acceptance_scenarios.when: run without / with a version-bound unexpired approval
acceptance_scenarios.then: refused without; with approval debt carries forward at min(recorded,current); an edited baseline digest fails; approvals are single-use (test_7, 7b, 7c)

risks: ci.yml overlap: additive step only; on a real conflict with open PR work touching ci.yml, stop with an overlap report (D-013-R067 pattern).
CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md additions must stay concise (base-context budget); details live in docs/CODE_MODULARITY_POLICY.md.
Baseline must be versioned and non-casually-regenerable; regeneration path requires reviewed exception evidence.
